method.method_draft: Read from the text that both hexagons are regular and that the large side length is twice the small side length. Use the image to identify the shapes as regular hexagons. Recall that a regular hexagon can be divided into 6 congruent equilateral triangles, so its area is proportional to the square of its side length: A=6*(sqrt(3)/4)s^2. If the small hexagon has side s and area 4, then the large has side 2s and area 6*(sqrt(3)/4)*(2s)^2 = 4 times the small area. Therefore the large area is 4*4=16 cm^2.
